notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Improved Cassie Attack Speed
 > We realized Cassie's starting attack speed is currently a bit slow relative to its upgrade. We decided to readjust the scaling of her attack speed.

- Adjusted HP Scaling based on difficulty
> As players dive through the game, most upgrades allow the player to exceed and outscale the bosses' HP. We adjusted the hard mode difficulty to give an even more challenging experience for the player.

- Fixed a bug where Matias summons spawn incorrectly
> Once one of the summons spawns outside of the fight zone, it will stop the boss from moving. We made sure the positions are moved to the correct coordinates.

- Update Kai animation
> We slightly improved Kai fight animation when he weaves through his attacks to make it blend more subtly.

- Fixed game freeze when on bandits/Morgana encounter
> Restarting fights sometime will freeze the game.

notes.title: Farsiders Full Release
notes.notes:
We, the team at Gambitghost Studio, wanted to express our heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support and interest in our game. Your passion and enthusiasm have been the driving force behind our journey, and we couldn't be more grateful. 

Here's some major updates for the full release version:
- Game's last chapter
Immerse yourself in the gripping final arc of the game, which promises an unforgettable conclusion to the FARSIDERS saga. Get ready for an emotional and thrilling ride!
- More Save Slots
For those of you who enjoy experimenting with different character builds or strategies, we're introducing additional save slots. Now you can take on the game's challenges from multiple angles.
- Difficulty Level
We've added different difficulty levels as to additional save slots, for those who wants easier or a more challenging experience. 
- Special cloak skin redemption for Kickstarter/TGS2022 supporter
Once again, we really appreciate your patience. Finally for those who backed us on Kickstarter, or participated last year's event: TGS2022, you can redeem the special cloak skin via Steam game activation.

Beside the above updates, we've also looked into several improvements for everyone including:
- Localization: TH
- Improved overall graphics
- Improved overall animation and cutscenes
- Improved overall user interfaces
- Fixed various bus

 
Please do not forget to update your game to the current version
We can't wait to share these new features with you and see how you tackle the challenges that await. 


Until then, Farsiders!
GambitGhost Studio

notes.title: Patch update and full release announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Farsiders,

We, the team at Gambitghost Studio, wanted to express our heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support and interest in our game. Your passion and enthusiasm have been the driving force behind our journey, and we couldn't be more grateful. 🙏

Since the beta release, your feedback and comments have been a valuable source of inspiration for us. We appreciate all the love and constructive criticism you've shared with us. Every comments have been taken to heart as we strive to make Farsiders the best possible gaming experience for you. 

We understand that a few unexpected issues have surfaced during gameplay, and we want to assure you that we are working diligently to address them. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we're pushing ourselves to resolve and polish these aspects.

Now, for the thrilling part! We're excited to share some fantastic updates and improvements that are just around the corner:

📅 On August 14th (9am UTC/4pm GMT+7):
- An introduction tutorial to help you navigate the game seamlessly.
- Additional game setting options for a personalized gaming experience.
- A captivating Zone introduction video that will immerse you even deeper into the Farsiders universe.
- Various bug fixes to enhance overall gameplay stability.

And that's not all! We have even bigger plans for the future:

📅 In late October, the full release will bring you:
- The gripping final arc of the game, delivering an unforgettable conclusion to the Farsiders saga.
- Exciting UI improvements to elevate your visual experience.
- Additional save slots for those who want to challenge the game with a different build.
- Additional Hard game difficulty recommended for veterans,


Thank you once again for being a part of the Farsiders community. We'll keep you informed every step of the way. If you have any thoughts, suggestions, or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out to us.


Best,
The Gambitghost Studio Team
